reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code is not something I usually see on TikTok Shop, and the empty-box guarantee means I'm not stuck with another half-used bottle. At $24.99 for the first box it's an easy impulse buy if the video hits my sleep problem.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? And I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I might just not finish the 30 days.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be generic or the batch number did not match, I would walk away. A clear explanation of why bisglycinate alone is enough would also push me over.
